summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine PDMR transactions: Maya Martinez-Davis, President US, sold 44,397 ADSs on the NYSE on 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-21 at prices around $52.14-$52.17. This is a standard insider sale notification, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, tender, or restructuring is involved. The filing merely discloses share sales by a company officer; it has no deal mechanics, premium, or recommendation. What to watch: none — routine disclosure, no risk-arb angle.
